Our Programs

A full day of learning and fun

Early-childhood curricula designed around curiosity — ages and activities grouped so every child learns at the right pace.

01 Ages 2–3

Little Explorers

Group play and cooperative activities that teach sharing, friendship, and confidence in a gentle first-steps setting.

02 Ages 3–4

Letters & Numbers

Reading, writing and counting fundamentals, introduced in a fun, simplified way that builds early victories step by step.

03 Ages 3–5

Art & Craft Studio

Drawing, coloring and hands-on crafts that grow imagination, focus, and fine motor skills one little project at a time.

04 Ages 4–5

Little Chef's Kitchen

Playful cooking experiences that awaken the senses and build independence — measuring, mixing, and tasting together.

From Our Days

Small steps, big wins

Why Baghdad Kids Academy?

For three years we have welcomed Baghdad's children with love. Our goal: your child loves school from day one and leaves each day with a new story for the dinner table.

Hours & Registration

We welcome children daily except Friday and Saturday, on a comfortable morning shift that fits family schedules. Registration is open for the current term — seats are limited.

Our Location

Harthiya — Kandi Street, by the TBI Bank branch, Baghdad. An easy, well-known drop-off spot for every morning routine.

Registration is open

Your child is in safe hands

Call us or message us on Instagram for inquiries and enrollment. Seats are limited so every child gets the attention they deserve.
